decisions.text: type stacked_bar_100: fractions of the total are the message, but the audience objects to pies: a 100 % stacked bar (G1.40, D-39)
scale 0–100 by 20: each total 100 %, its parts in % of it (R7-30, G7.32)
one total, Donations, stacked from its 6 parts
stacking order from the base: Germany, France, Italy, Sweden, Norway, All others (the largest at the base, where it is read precisely; All others at the top (R7-17); G7.31, D-26 (b))
each part in one colour and one place in every total: Germany (slot 1), France (slot 2), Italy (slot 3), Sweden (slot 4), Norway (slot 5), All others (all-others) (G4.22)
one total: one stack, standing upright (07 §5.4), its parts named beside it: vertical stacked bars
the unit's description on its own line above the scale (inline it would meet the stacked bar of Donations): “Share of all donations”; “100%” stays on the top label
each part named beside the stack, level with the middle of its segment, top to bottom as stacked: All others, Norway, Sweden, Italy, France, Germany (G5.4, D-31 (c))
the title wraps onto two lines

source.shows: fifteen countries brought under the part limit: the five largest named, the ten others lumped into All others, at the top of the stack whatever its size, in its warm grey (R7-17, G4.15, G7.31); a 100 % stack, the audience being averse to pies (G1.40, D-39; the pie is P3-03)
